nodes._comment: Z-Image Turbo (8-step distilled). Use z_image_bf16.safetensors for base (50-step) variant.
Type MUST be 'lumina2' — this is how ComfyUI routes to Z-Image's Qwen 3 4B text encoder
Sets shift=3 for S3-DiT noise schedule. Required for Z-Image.

widgets_values: Full body portrait, wide shot from head to toe. 90s OVA anime cel of a young woman with short blue-black hair, piercing red eyes, wearing a dark teal military-style jacket with gold epaulettes over a white turtleneck, dark pants, boots. Stern expression, standing in a relaxed pose with arms at sides, feet shoulder-width apart. Clean white background. Cel-shaded animation, visible paint strokes, muted color palette, anime screencap from 1992.
nodes._comment: Describe your character in detail. See z_img_expert/PREPROMPT.md for prompting guide. Lead with era/style, then body, clothing, pose, background.
Zeros negative conditioning. Z-Image Turbo ignores negative prompts (CFG=1). For Z-Image Base, replace this with a second CLIPTextEncode for the negative prompt.
Portrait dimensions for full-body character generation. 768x1024 gives a 3:4 aspect ratio.
Turbo settings: 8 steps, CFG 1.0, res_multistep sampler. For Z-Image Base: 50 steps, CFG 4.0, euler sampler, normal scheduler

_z_image_base_settings.negative_prompt: bad quality, worst quality, blurry, deformed, extra fingers

extra._prompt_guide: See ~/Documents/programs/creative/z_img_expert/PREPROMPT.md for full Z-Image prompting guide. Lead with style/era, describe subject, then pose, then background. Aim for 80-200 words.
